meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 组织 3 个漏洞猎手和 2 个 PoC 工程师并行审查代码库,验证漏洞是否真能被利用,按实际可利用性判定严重级别,最后产出含修复建议和结论(PASS/BLOCK)的报告。
howto.when: 当你要求做安全审查、漏洞研究、可利用性审计等,或输入 `/security-research` 时触发;需已开启 team-mode,并给出仓库、diff 范围或 PR 等具体目标。

say.text: 用 security-research 审查当前分支相对上游的 diff
say.note: 会先确认 team-mode 再并行审计

say.text: 对这个仓库做发布前安全审查,重点看认证和数据隔离
say.note: 3 个猎手分头找,2 个 PoC 工程师验证

say.text: 把这两个候选漏洞做成最小 PoC,验证是否真能被利用
say.note: 不可复现的候选会被降级

howto.what_en: Runs a Team Mode team of 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove or falsify exploitability, and return a severity-ranked report ending in PASS, PASS WITH FINDINGS, or BLOCK.
howto.when_en: Triggers on security review, vulnerability research, or exploitability audit requests, or /security-research. Requires team-mode and a concrete target such as a repo, diff range, or PR.

say_en.text: Run security-research on the current branch diff against upstream
say_en.note: Confirms team-mode first, then audits in parallel

say_en.text: Do a pre-release security review, focusing on auth and data isolation
Build a minimal PoC for these two candidate findings
say_en.note: Candidates that cannot be reproduced get downgraded
